# Tinlance World Intelligence

> Provenance-first temporal intelligence fabric for modeling, correlating, and monitoring real-world entities, events, relationships, change, signals, and source provenance. The repository is Python-based, Apache-2.0 licensed, and exposes a bounded read/query runtime plus a first-party World Monitor application surface.

## Project

- [README](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/README.md): Product boundary, quick start, runtime configuration, architecture, and semantic model.
- [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/pyproject.toml): Python project metadata and optional PostgreSQL runtime dependency.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release and change history.

## Tutorials

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/docs/README.md): Entry point to project documentation.
- [Quickstart tutorial](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/docs/tutorials/quickstart.md): Run the repository verification gate and bounded runtime locally.

## How-to

- [Run the runtime](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/docs/how-to/run-runtime.md): Configure and start the HTTP runtime in memory or PostgreSQL mode.
- [Validate migrations](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/docs/how-to/validate-database.md): Apply and verify the PostgreSQL/PostGIS migration sequence.
- [Add a source](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/docs/how-to/add-a-source.md): Extend source registration while preserving provenance and security boundaries.

## Explanation

- [Architecture](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/docs/explanation/architecture.md): Why the fabric separates source, artifact, observation, world state, change, signal, and intelligence.
- [Boundaries](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/docs/architecture/boundaries.md): Responsibility boundaries with ReconOS, TADS, Agent OS, and Agent Platform.
- [Security model](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/docs/explanation/security-model.md): Trust boundaries and untrusted-content handling.
- [Temporal model](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-world-intelligence/blob/main/docs/explanation/temporal-model.md): Event time, valid time, observation time, ingestion time, and knowledge-as-of semantics.
